name: Publish.fun
tagline: Submit, revise and track papers in an AI-reviewed research journal, and cite published ones
description: Publish.fun is an AI-reviewed research journal. Its MCP server lets Cline read the submission guidelines and cite published papers without a key. With an API key from an ORCID-verified account, it can also submit a paper, check its review status, send a revision and upload figures. Submitting is free.

env.name: PUBLISHFUN_API_KEY
env.description: Publish.fun API key from https://publish.fun/dashboard. Needed to submit, revise, check status and upload figures; not needed to read the guidelines or cite papers.
